title: REQ · resolveTextureKey returns the fallback asset id for unknown ids
summary: resolveTextureKey maps an asset id to itself when known and to the fallback id otherwise.
description: Context: missing assets must not crash rendering. Desired behavior: resolveTextureKey(id, manifest, fallbackId) returns id when the manifest has it, and returns fallbackId when the id is unknown or undefined. Expected result: a texture key that is always safe to use. Why: the scene needs a safe texture key for objects whose asset is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Given an id present in the manifest, when resolveTextureKey runs, then it returns that id.
Given an id absent from the manifest, when resolveTextureKey runs, then it returns the fallback id.
Given an undefined id, when resolveTextureKey runs, then it returns the fallback id.

preserve: FALLBACK_ASSET_ID value in the manifest loader

technical_constraints: The fallback id is passed in as a parameter, so the module does not import the node:fs-based loader
